description: The long one nobody else wants: parcel through Ironside Street to Voss Avenue, on to Cinder Lane, and all the way to Foundry Way before you turn back. It pays because it's a hike. 25₵.
name: The Long Haul

emotes: {who} hauls the load through Ironside Street, arms already burning.
{who} grunts, hikes the load higher, and keeps moving.
{who} pauses at Ironside Street just long enough to resettle the load.
{who} keeps hauling on to Voss Avenue, cursing whoever decided this needed doing on foot.
{who} switches the load to the other shoulder without breaking stride.
{who} trudges toward Voss Avenue, sweat running into their eyes.
{who} drags the load past Cinder Lane, sweating, refusing to put it down.
{who} staggers past Cinder Lane, arms shaking.
{who} mutters that this is the last job board gig they ever take.
{who} finally hauls it all the way to Foundry Way and drops it with a groan.
{who} sets the load down at Foundry Way and doesn't move for a second.
{who} collapses against a wall at Foundry Way, load finally delivered.
